scope: HTML prototype only; fixture similarities, no model/Android validation

results.check: Initial render has the v1.4.1 title and no JavaScript error
Recording has no added lexicon entry in all five modes and uses default packs in the background
History separates daily reports, review recordings, planning recordings and experience cards
Review no longer duplicates the experience-card module
Pack selection, term editing and revision persistence work independently
Returning from a pack refreshes the library and preserves selected packs
Creating an empty professional pack persists it without invented terms
Restoring a legacy backup migrates string hotwords into the professional pack without loss
Historical enrollment is reached directly from existing role details without an extra manager page
Fixture matching assigns only qualifying voices without training results back into the template
The plus button opens one recording form; finishing keeps fields and the ready state in that same page
Retry and saving stay in one workflow and return to the role list without another manager page
Closing the recorder cancels its timer and never creates a partial role
Manual merging preserves the name draft, assigns only selected evidence and updates linked quotes
Undo restores voice evidence and quote ownership after a merge
Undoing synthesis of a new person also removes the newly created role
Automatic clusters can be split and the do-not-merge constraints survive reload
A conflict constraint prevents a similarity chain from merging incompatible evidence
The page fits 320, 390 and 768 pixel viewports
All covered browser paths finish without uncaught JavaScript errors
